name: GetDimensions
caption: Get Dimensions

configuration.description: SmartField reference to the record, written as exactly one placeholder in double braces, e.g. "{{FindCustomers_results}}" or "{{trigger_Rec}}". It must resolve to a Reference (RecordId) in the flow context: an undotted name is looked up directly (an array reference such as {{FindX_results}} resolves to its first element, results[0]); a dotted path (e.g. {{trigger_Rec.Customer}}) is walked through the SmartField definitions. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Bare names without braces are rejected. The table must have a 'Dimension Set ID' field.
Table number of the referenced record (derived from the reference by the editor); must match at runtime.
Dimensions to read. Each distinct code produces two value outputs.

items.description: Dimension code to read. Trimmed and upper-cased; duplicates and empty codes are ignored.
Written by the editor on repeater rows; ignored by this step.

outputs.name: <DIMENSIONCODE>
outputs.when: one per configured dimension code (upper-cased): the dimension value code, '' if the record has no value for it

outputs.name: <DIMENSIONCODE>_Name
outputs.when: one per configured code: the dimension value name, '' if none

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be present and a non-zero integer.
configuration.tableNo is read as an integer (missing, null, non-integer -> 0); 0 fails the step.
rules.message: Table No. is required for a Get Dimensions step.

rules.check: tableNo must be a JSON number (integer); other JSON types are not reliably converted and are treated as 0.
rules.message: Table No. is required for a Get Dimensions step.

rules.check: configuration.reference must be present and non-empty.
configuration.reference must be a single SmartField placeholder: after trimming it starts with '{{', ends with '}}' and has a non-empty name inside.
The reference must resolve to an existing record reference in the flow context at run time.
rules.message: Reference "%1" cannot be resolved to a record.

rules.check: The table of the resolved record must equal configuration.tableNo.
rules.message: Reference resolves to table %1 but the step is configured for table %2.

rules.check: The table must have a field named 'Dimension Set ID'.
rules.message: Table "%1" has no "Dimension Set ID" field, so dimensions cannot be set on it.

rules.check: dimensions should be a JSON array; other types produce no outputs.

notes: Output names are the upper-cased dimension codes, so outputs[] must list e.g. {"name":"DEPARTMENT","type":"value"} and {"name":"DEPARTMENT_Name","type":"value"} for each code, in configuration order; reference them as {{slug_DEPARTMENT}} / {{slug_DEPARTMENT_Name}}.
A dimension code that does not exist, or is not on the record, simply yields empty outputs (no error).
The table-missing error message mentions 'set' because it is shared with Set Dimension Values.
